$comment: Contract for the MoveQuestion server-side command (AD-003, AD-122). A move is a retire plus an add in one transaction, never a lookup update. Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_MoveQuestion
customApi.description: Retires a question in its current section and creates it in the target, carrying its wording, response type and mandatory flag, so history stays attached to the section the answers were written in. Refuses the codes compiled logic depends on. Enforces Edit on question.retire and audits immutably.

requestParameters.name: QuestionId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_question to move.

requestParameters.name: TargetSectionId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_section to move it to.

requestParameters.name: NewQuestionCode
requestParameters.description: Code for the question in its new section; codes are unique and never freed.

requestParameters.name: EffectiveFrom
requestParameters.description: Optional yyyy-MM-dd for the new question. Absent is today.

requestParameters.name: Reason
requestParameters.description: Why the question is moving. Required and recorded on the Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: RetiredVersionId
responseProperties.description: Id of the al_questionversion dated out in the old section.

responseProperties.name: NewQuestionId
responseProperties.description: Id of the al_question created in the target section.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when an optimistic-concurrency conflict was detected.
